4. A case under Sections 307, 353, 328, 270, 273 r/w.34 of IPC and Section 59(1) of Food Safety and Standards Act was registered against the petitioners along with other accused.
5. Other accused in this case, who is accused No.5, already approached this Court by way of filing Criminal Petition No.2820 of 2020 under Section 482 Cr.P.C. seeking quash of the aforesaid F.I.R.

This Court by order dated 07.08.2020 partly allowed the said criminal Petition and quashed the F.I.R. in Crime No.716 of 2019 of Anakapalli Town Police Station, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 353, 328, 270, 273 r/w. Secs.34 and 109 of IPC and Section 59(1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
The Court ordered that the investigation in respect of the offence under Section 307 of IPC shall go on.

6. Therefore, the petitioners herein, who are accused Nos.1 and 2 in the above Crime, who are facing the same allegations on par with accused No.5, who is similarly placed, are also entitled to the similar order.
7. Therefore, in view of the earlier order passed by this Court in Crl.Petition No.2820 of 2020 quashing the F.LR.
